name: KiraFlux-Toolkit
description: Header-only C++20 library for ESP32 (Arduino). CRTP static polymorphism with selective dynamic polymorphism, no exceptions, type-safe error handling via Result and Option. Modules for GPIO, buses (I2C/SPI/UART), drivers (SSD1306, ST7735, servo, motor, quadrature encoder), sensors, graphics, and a widget-based UI.
